pre_registration.motivation: reports/bet_diagnostics.md: among bets with calibrated P >= 55%, Unders won more often than predicted in every era (+2.3, +7.8, +7.4 points in 2011-18, 2018-21, 2021-26) and Overs slightly less (-0.3, -1.3, -1.0). A mechanism check (exploration on 2011-21, where half scores exist): overtime happens in 6-7% of games and adds about 24 points when it does (+1.4 to +1.6 to the mean total), so totals are right-skewed. The mean residual against the opener is +0.7 to +0.85 points but the median is 0 to +0.5; Overs hit 50.0-50.8% while the normal model's average P(over) is 52.4-53.0%. The locked calibrator is symmetric (P(win) depends only on side*mu/sd and the buffer), so it cannot remove an Over/Under asymmetry.
pre_registration.data: The cached walk-forward predictions of the locked v3 engine (data/processed cache, fingerprinted). Calibrators are refitted walk-forward exactly as locked: for season s, fitted on the out-of-sample predictions of earlier seasons only, with the same season weights (calib_decay 0.6) and pseudo-bets.

candidates.C0_locked: locked calibrator: b0 + b1*s_model + b2*s_buf + b3*s_buf^2 + b4*s_model*s_buf
candidates.C1_side: C0 + b5*side (Over +1, Under -1); one extra parameter
candidates.C2_side_buffer: C1 + b6*side*s_buf + b7*side*s_buf^2; the alternate-line curve may differ by side (skewed tails)

metrics.primary: log loss of the two-sided P(over) at the opening line, every calibrated eligible non-push game, per era
secondary: P >= 55% singles at the opener: bets, win rate, win minus predicted by side, ROI at -110 (all eras), ROI at the best book's real price (2021-26)
pseudo-bet log loss over the alternate-line buffers (pricing of card legs), per era
2.5+ target cards with real prices, 2021-26, locked stage-3 products (re-analysis)

pre_registration.adoption_rule: A candidate is adopted only if its primary log loss is lower than C0's in EACH of the three eras AND its pooled P >= 55% ROI at -110 (2011-26) is not lower than C0's. If both candidates qualify, C1 is chosen unless C2 has a lower primary log loss than C1 in each era (fewer parameters win ties). Adopted means: the live engine records the adopted calibrator's picks next to C0's in the 2026-27 forward ledger, and the forward season decides which one is used after it.

not_candidates_now.books_at_open: 6+ books at the open did better in 2021-26 (57.8% vs 55.6%), but no earlier data has book counts; logged in the forward ledger instead
not_candidates_now.extreme_shrink: P >= 62% looked overconfident in the later eras on only 55-70 bets; too few to act on
not_candidates_now.neutral_site: neutral-site bets beat their predictions but are mostly Unders; re-checked after the side term, not tested separately
